answer: One concrete defense is bonded identity staking: every agent must lock scarce collateral to act, so spinning up a thousand fake personas demands a thousand real deposits. Honest work lets reputation ripple outward through signed peer attestations, while a quiet whisper of doubt from a counterparty can slash a cheater considerable bond. A sybil swarm then burns like a comet, bright, brief, and bankrupt, because duplicating stake costs more than any fraud it could ever earn.
